questions.question: The farmer has 240 sheep and 3/4 of them are white. How many white sheep are there? Show your working.
questions.expected_answer: Divide by the denominator: 240 ÷ 4 = 60, so 1/4 of the flock is 60 sheep. Multiply by the numerator: 3 × 60 = 180 white sheep.

questions.question: 4 friends share 7 pizzas equally. How much does each get? Explain with the pizzas.
questions.expected_answer: Each friend gets 1 whole pizza, using 4 pizzas. The other 3 pizzas are cut into quarters, giving 12 quarters, so each friend gets 3 quarters more. Each gets 1 and 3/4 pizzas, which is 7/4.

questions.question: A jacket costs R450 and has 1/5 off. Find the discount and the sale price.
questions.expected_answer: 1/5 of R450 is R450 ÷ 5 = R90, which is the discount. The sale price is R450 − R90 = R360.
